summary: Tested all 6 requested items end-to-end. Backend: new pytest suite (12 tests) covering child OTP send/verify + PUT /api/profile/child gating, moments 2/month quota + 429, activation sync, signup password rule, and OTP rate limits — 12/12 pass. Full backend suite: 207 passed / 12 failed (all pre-existing AsyncMock/Stripe/redis-mock test-infra failures; the previously flaky OTP-collision e2e failure was fixed). Frontend (Playwright, preview URL): signup <8 char inline error, OTP gate on /onboarding step 0 (Continue disabled until verified, dev_code toast, wrong code rejected, verified badge, Continue advances to plan step), phone-edit-after-verify correctly drops the badge and re-disables Continue, moment quota badge 2→1→0 with 'Limit reached' disabled send after 2 moments, and onboarding Activate Care Circle → dashboard shows 'Active'.

minor.issue: test_rate_limit_unit (2), test_otp_unit::test_send_otp_sms_error_handling, test_auth_unit::test_revoke_token_is_blacklisted, test_translation_engine_unit (2), test_distress_detection_unit, test_sarvam_stt_unit, test_escalation_unit::test_birthday_and_afternoon_logic, test_api_payments_webhook (3) fail due to AsyncMock/Stripe/redis mock wiring, not product code

ui_bugs.issue: After successful activation the app navigates to /activation but is immediately bounced to /dashboard by the `if (user?.onboarding_complete) navigate('/dashboard')` effect that fires after refreshUser(). Frame navigation trace: /onboarding -> /activation -> /dashboard. Users never see the 'Your care circle is active 🎉' + how-to-reply training page.

Internal dial/num state is initialised from the `value` prop only on mount (useEffect with [] deps). If child.phone arrives/changes asynchronously after mount (e.g. /auth/me prefill landing while the user is typing), the visible digits and the value actually used for OTP diverge — reproduced once: input showed the edited number while the verification card sent the OTP to the old prefilled number.

Continue (step0-next) becomes enabled while the consent checkbox is unchecked; consent is only enforced by a toast after clicking. Consider including childConsent in the disabled condition for consistency with the OTP gate.

issues: No visual defects found: quota badge, disabled 'Limit reached' state, OTP card states and contrast all render correctly at 1920x1080

action_items: Fix the /activation redirect race so the activation success/how-to-reply page is actually shown (e.g. skip the onboarding_complete->/dashboard redirect when activate() has already navigated, or navigate after unmount/replace).
Sync PhoneInput internal state with the `value` prop (add value to the useEffect deps or derive dial/num from props) to avoid displayed-vs-actual phone divergence.
Optional: include childConsent in the step0-next disabled condition.
Optional: repair the 12 pre-existing AsyncMock/Stripe/redis mock unit tests so the suite is green.
critical_code_review_comments: Moment cap is enforced by counting documents before insert without a transaction/unique guard — two concurrent POST /api/moments can both pass the `used >= MOMENTS_PER_MONTH` check (race allows a 3rd moment). Consider an atomic counter or conditional update.
PUT /api/profile/child gates on _normalize_phone(phone_verified_number) == _normalize_phone(payload.phone) — correct; verified that changing the phone after verification re-blocks (400).

OTP send rate limit is 3 per 10 min per phone; tests that hardcode phone numbers collide. Added a `unique_phone` conftest fixture and used it in the 3 e2e onboarding tests (was causing a flaky 429 failure under xdist).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use Bearer tokens for backend tests — CSRF validation is bypassed for Authorization: Bearer. In the onboarding UI, sonner stacks toasts so multiple 'Test mode code: XXXXXX' matches can appear — try each code or read dev_code from the API. Run tests/seed_ui_user.py [--no-activate] to seed a fully onboarded user for UI runs.
rca_of_the_issue: Activation page skip: Onboarding.activate() calls await refreshUser() before navigate('/activation'); the refreshed user has onboarding_complete=true, so Onboarding's mounted effect `if (user?.onboarding_complete) navigate('/dashboard')` runs on the next render and overrides the /activation navigation. PhoneInput desync: useEffect([]) initialises local dial/num once, so later prop changes (async prefill) are not reflected in the input.
